trigger.finding: The 11 primary candidates collapse to 5 unique trajectoryHash-plus-ply events, and the 7 expansion candidates collapse to 2 such events. Six expansion rows share one identical candidate state and trajectory.
trigger.timing: Registered before any formal E-011 corpus generation.

requiredSecondaryOutputs: unique trajectoryHash-plus-ply candidate and control counts
raw capture-branch-expansion rates and risk ratio
trajectoryHash-plus-ply deduplicated capture-branch-expansion rates and risk ratio

decisionPolicy.interpretation: The original E-011 event-level decision remains the preregistered primary decision. Any divergence between raw and deduplicated endpoints must be reported and constrains claims of structural generality.

changePolicy: This supplement is additive. It may not be used to retroactively relax the base preregistration or to replace an unfavorable primary decision.
